Seltny to +Tou BRIGIPA CHAPA KA'ATTAIANIO AGANANI Ia brigipa chapa ka'attaianio adita ruuta somoiko ra'na nangahani gimin, poraigiparangna bakbakkale on'na manjaha ;; maina reanggipa adita bilsirangna chapa ka'ani lekarangko man'na nenganichi aro chapa kaani korosrang rang'san tang-doanichi chapa ka'aniko arbachengatna man'ningjaha.
Iako chapa ka'attaianio anga Garo Hills Book Emporiumni Shri Sushil Kr.
Das-ko mitelna ga aka maina ua banga nengnikanirang dongoba chapa ka'aniko jako rae da'o matchotatna man'aha.
Haida ia chapa ka'attainio gualanirang dongode, ka'sapae angna uiatpaode mitelbeani ong'genchim.
SALLINGNI AGANA BALROROKARI Salguri mitmat mitmat, Wa'ambong tiptap tiptap ; A-sro siao siao, Salchichaa mitchao mitchao.
A-kinte chadipana sipsap, Agatek aba tua gekgak, Aan'ma manggisijok, Bolnima jakrurongjok.
Wa'an'ma bangsi sike, A-ko dimu kitbajok ; Bolnima knal sike Bolko bijak akbajok.
WACHI KARI A-galmak simnil simil, Chiabak kimil kimil ; Sangkira a gil pinjok, Mikkasim jarim simjok.
A-mong a'du so-ako mikmak, Chikol an'cheng danako dandak.
Bolchim bite rongrongte dakjok ; Ang-ke danok parangga bitjok.
--- Page 10 --- SEOKGIMIN POETRYRANG Dimbil chama chatmiting bakritjak Bolo, ta'jong wegajok jakripat.
Am'pang agal baliping baljok ; Taja narot gongriting chajok.
Jongtikket tikket, tikket ; A-kisang mitek, mitek ; Chiringo mite achak bekbak ; Patalo domaski jikjak.
A-skochi doabot tengtang, Bolgrimo jingjingbeng chengchang.
Bri rike snaru baljok ; Chiring chisik chiwaring tangjok.
Wachi dilma a kinte golijok ; Misi a'ma bolganchi suakjok.
Bima na'tok sambalna dojok, Bolni bite agatchi minjok.
Mikkasim pripri, Bolko dodol dokmiting ; Samsmit mri mri, Jong-dol nating bitmiting.
MISI KARI Misi a'ma gakuteng ongjok ; Saksan aba mikkuteng tujok.
Salniango chenggari satjok ; Rongbirako sepru maljok.
